authorship: Codex visual inspection of r0 screenshot; no model generated these critiques
observation: Polished cohesive sci-fi start screen with excellent hierarchy. Weaknesses are small mission copy, visually repetitive upgrade cards, and excessive black around the compact central stack.

independent_axis_critiques.layout: Increase the central stack modestly and connect briefing, upgrades and CTA as one console.
independent_axis_critiques.spacing: Use a tighter internal grid but slightly wider overall console footprint.
independent_axis_critiques.color_type: Increase mission text readability; preserve cyan/yellow signal hierarchy.
independent_axis_critiques.style_orig: Differentiate upgrade modules with small technical diagrams/state bars rather than more glow.

cross_critique_tradeoff: Filling space risks losing cinematic restraint. Expand the console, not the amount of content, and avoid extra neon effects.
fused_revision: This is already strong. Refine rather than redesign: enlarge the central command console modestly, improve mission-copy size and contrast, differentiate the three upgrade modules with restrained technical meters or icon geometry, and make the CTA the unequivocal endpoint. Preserve the black/cyan tactical identity, perspective grid, header HUD and current content; avoid adding glow or extra panels.
axes_moderated_revision: Unify briefing, upgrade row and CTA into a slightly wider console grid with aligned edges. Normalize vertical gaps and card padding. Increase briefing typography for real readability while keeping cyan labels and yellow credit accents. Give each upgrade a distinct but consistent diagram/meter and refine hover/selected states without increasing visual noise.
mad_moderated_revision: Keep the cinematic negative space and current identity. Widen only the central console, align all of its edges, and enlarge the mission text. Differentiate upgrades through tiny functional meters and icon shapes rather than color proliferation. Strengthen CTA focus, preserve the sparse HUD and perspective backdrop, and introduce no new content or decorative glow.
